[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6559/diffs?diff_id=362779886&start_sha=10e89f8a75f0b136ed9def3c65c8df2712193dc4)
use value_string or TFS
Switched to TFS, thanks!

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6559/diffs?diff_id=363058944&start_sha=41c45056b8e7bbecaf41c5d39bba39e04dd5f7fd#563035828d54f54675fb43da590218eab9a7bee2_178_178)

can you attach a pcap ?

may be use the same idea like vendor specific on packet-80211.c

added 1 commit
  • b5827063 - Use TFS for GCP direction bit.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6559/diffs?diff_id=363058944&start_sha=41c45056b8e7bbecaf41c5d39bba39e04dd5f7fd)

Please see pcap here:
[geneve2.pcap](/uploads/8e9a35a6d5c9a343386e18eb857d01c1/geneve2.pcap)

I don't think it would get that complicated. Only a handful of vendors are likely relevant, and each would use a just few options. [AWS defined 3 as well](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/networking-and-content-delivery/integrate-your-custom-logic-or-appliance-with-aws-gateway-load-balancer/).
only dissect if GCP/Google ?
That's possible, but I'm not sure what the gain is. AWS will surely be next in line, and switch is very efficient.
can be a conflict of number ?
The switch is done on the opt_class and opt_type together, so a conflict is not possible.

use proto_tree_add_item and bitmask value

can you also display unused/reserved bits ?
Changed. The 3 reserved bits are not interesting, seems better not to display them.
we prefer always to display all bytes (can be used a day...)
OK, added.
use 32 for length

changed this line in [version 4 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/6559/diffs?diff_id=363675326&start_sha=b582706356f410fdd00148a982bc99f42b2c9a84#563035828d54f54675fb43da590218eab9a7bee2_414_414)
can you squash change too ?
